// Classifier fixture, node:test: the SNAPSHOT assertion class and its negative. Read as text by
// tests/classify.test.ts.
import { test } from "node:test";

test("renders the welcome email", (t) => {
  t.assert.snapshot(renderEmail("welcome"));
});

test("renders the welcome subject", (t) => {
  t.assert.deepStrictEqual(renderEmail("welcome").subject, "Welcome");
});
